cards.back: A number that can be split into 2 equal groups with none left. It ends in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.
cards.say: Even number. A number that can be split into two equal groups with none left. It ends in zero, two, four, six or eight.

cards.back: A number that leaves 1 left over when split into 2 groups. It ends in 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9.
cards.say: Odd number. A number that leaves one left over when split into two groups. It ends in one, three, five, seven or nine.
Is twenty-four odd or even? Even. It ends in four.
Is thirty-seven odd or even? Odd. It ends in seven.
Is fifty-eight odd or even? Even. It ends in eight.
Is sixty-one odd or even? Odd. It ends in one.
Is seventy odd or even? Even. It ends in zero.
Is eighty-five odd or even? Odd. It ends in five.
Is ninety-two odd or even? Even. It ends in two.
Is ninety-nine odd or even? Odd. It ends in nine.
Is one hundred odd or even? Even. It ends in zero.
Is forty-three odd or even? Odd. It ends in three.
Even plus even is always even. Four plus six equals ten.
Odd plus odd is always even. Three plus five equals eight.
Odd plus even is always odd. Three plus four equals seven.

cards.back: 9. These are odd numbers, going up by 2.
cards.say: What comes next? One, three, five, seven, what? Nine. These are odd numbers, going up by two.

cards.back: 20. These are even numbers, going up by 2.
cards.say: What comes next? Twelve, fourteen, sixteen, eighteen, what? Twenty. These are even numbers, going up by two.

cards.front: I am even, between 30 and 40, and my ones digit is 6. Who am I?
cards.say: I am even, between thirty and forty, and my ones digit is six. Who am I? Thirty-six.

cards.front: I am odd, I have 5 tens, and my ones digit is 1 more than 4. Who am I?
cards.say: I am odd, I have five tens, and my ones digit is one more than four. Who am I? Fifty-five.
Name the smallest odd two-digit number. Eleven.
Name the largest even two-digit number. Ninety-eight.

cards.front: Is double any number odd or even?
cards.back: Even. Double always makes two equal groups.
cards.say: Is double any number odd or even? Even. Double always makes two equal groups.

cards.front: Are all numbers in the 10 times table even?
cards.say: Are all numbers in the ten times table even? Yes. They end in zero.

cards.front: Are all numbers in the 5 times table odd?
cards.back: No. 10 and 20 are in it and they are even.
cards.say: Are all numbers in the five times table odd? No. Ten and twenty are in it and they are even.
